audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is framed around 'sidestep his W dash, then punish' — advice that cannot be executed.
audit.why: Riot on Twisted Advance: 'Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming UNTARGETABLE and dashing to the TARGET.' It is target-locked, so it cannot be sidestepped, and it cannot be hit in flight. The punish window is the 14 seconds after it resolves, not the dash itself.
audit.corrected: Eat the root, then all-in the cooldown — rewritten in early, mid, whys[3], wants.you[1] and phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike is described without a single number, and whys[4] calls Hero's Entrance a 'global rotation'.
audit.why: Twisted Advance 14/13/12/11/10, Bramble Smash 7/6.5/6/5.5/5, Sapling Toss 18/17/16/15/14, Nature's Grasp 130/110/90. Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 at 4000/4750/5500 onto an ALLY, not global.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid, spikes[1] and dosFull[0].d; the global claim corrected to a 4000-unit rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer says what Galio's own poke does to Maokai's passive.
audit.why: Riot on Sap Magic: 'Each time Maokai casts a spell OR IS STRUCK BY AN ENEMY'S SPELL, this cooldown is reduced.' Winds of War is a damage-over-time spell, so idle tornado poke actively accelerates the heal the page tells you to out-damage.
audit.corrected: Hold the tornado for commits and buy Grievous Wounds early — written into early, spikes[2] and report[8].

audit.whatIsWrong: Bramble Smash's knockback is mentioned twice but never connected to Galio's taunt.
audit.why: Shield of Durand's range is 275 and Riot's text for Bramble Smash is 'knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave'. Displacement out of a 275 radius means the release taunt catches nothing, and Bramble Smash is only 7 seconds at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Written into mid, whys[2], wants.foe[0] and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: R (Hero's Entrance) into W-taunt and E knockup is a real all-in on an immobile target who can't dash away once his W (Twisted Advance) root is on cooldown.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is untargetable while he dashes, so let it land and root you — then punish the 14 seconds after with Hero's Entrance, the taunt and the knockup.

edits.before: Sidestep his W (Twisted Advance) dash, then W-taunt into E (Justice Punch) knockup while he has no root to answer
edits.after: His W (Twisted Advance) is untargetable in flight — wait it out, then taunt into the knockup during its 14 seconds

edits.before: Land W (Twisted Advance) on you to lock you for a Q (Bramble Smash) knockback into sapling burst
edits.after: Dash in untargetable with Twisted Advance, root him, then knock him back out of his 275 taunt

edits.before: Maokai pre-6 is just sapling chip and the threat of his W (Twisted Advance) root, so respect the bush — if he lands the W dash he gets a free Q (Bramble Smash) knockback and a sapling combo on you. Last-hit safely with the center column of your Q (Winds of War) where his saplings can't trade with you for free, and don't channel W (Shield of Durand) into nothing since his damage is sustained chip, not the burst your channel is built to sponge. Once you have Q plus E by level 3 you out-range his poke and can punish any step-up with W-taunt into E (Justice Punch) knockup.
edits.after: Maokai pre-6 is sapling chip and the threat of his W (Twisted Advance) root, so respect the bush — the dash is UNTARGETABLE in flight, so nothing you throw at it lands, and he arrives rooting you into a Q (Bramble Smash) knockback and a sapling combo. Note what your own poke does: Sap Magic's cooldown drops every time an enemy SPELL strikes him, so a lazy Winds of War tornado refills the heal you are trying to out-damage. Last-hit with the center column, hold the tornado for commits, and from level 3 punish any step-up with the W-taunt into E (Justice Punch) knockup.

edits.before: This is your window. Maokai is immobile once his W (Twisted Advance) root is on cooldown, so bait it out — sidestep the dash, then W-taunt, E-knockup through him, and drop the Q tornado on top for a trade he can't kite. At 6 your Hero's Entrance turns any caught W-cooldown into a kill threat, and just as valuably it lets you R to another lane and take over the map while this one sits even. His Sap Magic passive heals the chip, not a committed combo, so make him eat the full W-E-Q rather than trading autos into his sustain.
edits.after: This is your window, but not by dodging the dash — Twisted Advance is untargetable while it travels, so let it resolve and count the 14 seconds before it returns. Inside that window: E-knockup through him, charge W and release the taunt, tornado on top. Watch the radius, because Shield of Durand only taunts at 275 and Bramble Smash knocks you back out of it every 7 seconds. At 6 Hero's Entrance turns any caught W-cooldown into a kill threat, and lands you on an ally 4000 units away to take the map.

edits.before: Around your first AP item your Q poke and amplified Shield of Durand uptime let you win extended fights his Sap Magic passive can't fully refund.
edits.after: Your first AP item wins extended fights, but buy Grievous Wounds with it — every spell that strikes him cuts Sap Magic's healing cooldown down.

edits.before: With Q-W-E online your W-taunt into E (Justice Punch) knockup punishes any step-up, and his Sap Magic passive only heals the chip, not the full combo.
edits.after: With Q-W-E online the taunt into the knockup punishes any step-up — but Bramble Smash knocks you back out of Shield of Durand's 275 taunt radius.

edits.before: You out-trade an immobile Maokai whose W root is his only gap-close — force it, dodge it, then all-in the cooldown.
edits.after: His W is untargetable in flight, so you cannot punish the dash — eat it, then all-in the 14 seconds it is gone.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance gives you a kill all-in on a no-dash target and, more importantly, a global rotation to swing other lanes.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance gives you a kill all-in on a no-dash target and a 4000-unit rotation onto any ally to swing other lanes.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — His lock-on root. Dodge it. Track it before every punch. - Your W: the trade-flipper — never burn it early. - Your R: a map-wide win condition — spend it on allies' fights.
edits.after: - Twisted Advance: 14s at rank 1, 10s maxed, and UNTARGETABLE in flight — you punish the cooldown, never the dash. - Bramble Smash: 7s, and the knockback pushes you out of your own 275 taunt. - Your W: 18s. - Your E: 11s.

edits.before: Track Maokai's Twisted Advance (Root): His lock-on root. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-poke + punch the gap.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is untargetable while it travels — nothing you throw hits it. Punish the 14 seconds after.

edits.before: - Galio vs Maokai - Track: Maokai Twisted Advance. - Punch only on its cooldown. - W is the trade-flipper, never burn it early. - Shove + R-roam from 6. - Anti-heal if he sustains.
edits.after: - Galio vs Maokai - Twisted Advance is untargetable in flight: punish the 14s after, not the dash. - Bramble Smash knocks you out of your 275 taunt. - Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only punch once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Untargetable in flight, 14s at rank 1. Punch once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Maokai's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: You cannot hit him mid-dash anyway — he is untargetable until he lands on you.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Stormsurge / Riftmaker, then Zhonya's Hourglass; boots Mercury's Treads. Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Stormsurge / Riftmaker, then Zhonya's; boots Mercury's Treads. Oblivion Orb early — every spell you land speeds his Sap Magic heal.

edits.before: Full kit online. E-punch windows open strictly on Twisted Advance's cooldown — the dash is interruptible and root-able mid-flight.
edits.after: Full kit online. E-punch windows open only after Twisted Advance resolves — it is untargetable in flight, so you cannot stop it.

notes: The load-bearing fix is that Twisted Advance cannot be dodged or interrupted: Riot's text has Maokai 'becoming UNTARGETABLE and dashing to the target', and the page told the player to sidestep it in four places. The second find is that Winds of War feeds Sap Magic — the passive's cooldown drops each time an enemy SPELL strikes him, so poking a Maokai who wants to sustain is self-defeating unless Grievous Wounds is already on. Small sample (15 games) but the mechanics are sample-independent. UNVERIFIED: the kit derives a grounding flag on Bramble Smash that Riot's description does not support (knockback, damage and slow only), so no grounding claim was written — the knockback-out-of-taunt-radius line is marked Medium because it follows from the 275 range rather than from explicit text.
